Hi, I'm Mia! Welcome to My Kitchen ❤️

I started Viral Mia out of pure weeknight exhaustion. As a 20-something living in a cozy apartment with a tiny kitchen, I was tired of food blogs that required 25 rare ingredients, 3 different mixing bowls, and 2 hours of cleanup.

My culinary philosophy is simple: Food should be fast, deeply comforting, and zero-stress.

Every single recipe and kitchen hack on this site is tested to ensure it takes 15-20 minutes or less, uses everyday grocery staples (from Trader Joe's, Aldi, or Walmart), and leaves you with minimal dishes.

Thank you for stopping by my cozy corner of the internet. Grab an apron, pour a glass of whatever makes you happy, and let's cook something delicious!
